items.prompt: A has too many documents to prepare alone. Complete A's request for help:

result.traditional: 等一下資料很多，我一個人忙不過來，你可以幫我嗎？
result.simplified: 等一下资料很多，我一个人忙不过来，你可以帮我吗？
result.pinyin: Děng yíxià zīliào hěn duō, wǒ yí ge rén mángbúguòlái, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ ma?
result.english: There are lots of documents for later; I can't handle it alone, could you help me?

repairs.note: 忙得過來 means capable of handling alone; here help is needed (忙不過來).

我們快把它放回大海，看看它能不能
